reviews.title: Read this review
reviews.text: This VPN at first I had absolutely no issues with it always connected very quickly. Since abroad I need to connect to a UK vpn since that is where I am from and most of my apps do not work without being connected to UK. I do not have the premium version but now every time I try and connect it always says the connection is blocked. This is an ongoing issue and I decided to pay  for premium but as expected no luck either. This VPN likes to take at least 4/5 minutes to connect which by then most of the time has run out, meaning I have to watch more ads to compensate. I am not sure whether there is a bug or too many users but the wonders of this VPN really need to set it out. I have tried connecting with other servers and the best one that connects is Europe which is of no use to me.

reviews.title: Only free for 30 minutes
reviews.text:
Claims to offer “a 100% free VPN service with the support of in-app ads-access to fast and secure servers worldwide without any limitations.”
Not true - the free service is limited to 30 minutes, the server location is chosen at random and every feature listed in the misleading description is only accessible by paying £9.99 per week. So two stars for offering a limited free mode - I might add more if the description is rewritten so it clearly shows what’s free and what you need to pay for.
